headline: Binance Intake Rose To 1,596.2 Million Dollars From 1,183.0 Million
narrative: Exchanges took in 1,791.1 million dollars over 24 hours, 0.6695 percent of custodied value excluding each venue's own token, up from 1,212.9 million dollars at 0.4524 percent. The figure is the change in dollars held on trading venues, so a positive print means money arrived where holders can sell, and Binance took in 1,596.2 million dollars of that intake, up from 1,183.0 million. Bybit took in 105.3 million dollars and OKX took in 52.6 million, while Bitget shed 54.7 million dollars.
author: jordan
